bgassistant.hotkeys.doc:
Opt-in Windows shortcuts without keyboard hooks or input collection.

Construction is inert. Only explicit ``start`` registers two fixed shortcuts on
the UI thread. A private message-only window owns their WM_HOTKEY messages, so
polling never drains another component's thread messages. Demo mode should never
start this component; offline tests inject FakeBackend rather than native APIs.

bgassistant.artwork.doc:
Bounded, asynchronous cache of genuine Hearthstone card renders.

Only catalogued card IDs reach HearthSim's fixed HTTPS artwork host. Images are
Blizzard game materials hosted by HearthstoneJSON, not images generated by this
client. Network responses never contain executable content or arbitrary URLs.
Tk/ImageTk objects must be created by the UI thread from the returned PIL copy.

bgassistant.hud.doc:
Pure local HUD metadata from already observed, public game information.

This module neither reads a process nor contacts a server. It deliberately does
not extend the model DTO: rank-to-portrait mapping, visible counters and unknown
clock data are presentation concerns. A missing tag stays unknown, even when the
model representation uses zero as its default.

bgassistant.tracker.doc: Local presentation state from observed frames; no model or simulator imports.

notes: Power.log 解析器/GameTag 映射/内存读取/protocol 等核心模块与 0.5.3 字节级完全一致，说明 0.6.1 没有为 37.0.0.255130 更新解析/规则表。
新增模块全部是 UI/悬浮窗/卡图/热键/本地展示，不是模拟器或模型。
hotkeys 使用 RegisterHotKey/WM_HOTKEY，不安装键盘钩子、不采集输入、不注入游戏。
artwork 会访问固定 HearthSim/HearthstoneJSON 卡图主机；这是新增的网络面，与本项目引擎无关。
